description: Insert an inline image into a Google Document from a publicly accessible URL

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

height.description: Height of the image in points

imageUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL to the image

index.description: The index (1-based) where the image should be inserted

width.description: Width of the image in points

name: insertImageFromUrl
